title: Velvety Ukrainian Wagyu Tartare
description: A fresh and indulgent Ukrainian dish featuring wagyu beef, served in a cazuela and made with raw-friendly ingredients, this velvety tartare is a delight to the senses, with a glassy-jelly texture that will leave you wanting more.

ingredients.name: Microgreens
ingredients.notes: such as pea shoots or purslane

instructions: Begin by finely chopping the wagyu beef and placing it in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped shallots, capers, pickled mustard seeds, and a pinch of fleur de sel.
Add the shallot mixture to the bowl with the wagyu beef and mix gently until just combined.
Stir in the truffle oil and season with additional fleur de sel to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir in the quail egg yolks until the mixture is smooth and velvety.
Spoon the tartare into a cazuela or small serving dish and garnish with microgreens.
Serve the tartare with toasted rye bread and softened unsalted butter on the side.
Encourage guests to spread a small amount of butter onto the bread, top with a spoonful of the tartare, and enjoy.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
